value: At Lantern Hill, the Lantern Accord is hosting its trade fair. Apparently, the jade sculpture from Gladwater is drawing a considerable amount of attention among the gathered traders. It’s the latest item making the rounds, which is more than saying anything about the stability of those imports. Meanwhile, reports filtering back from the Reedmother's Children indicate a successful fishing season. They claim the bounty has been plentiful. As usual, the bigger the harvest, the more the promises of fair exchange become strained. We await whether the market proves as fruitful as the nets.
